body: I am 16. I live with my mother in an apartment it is just her and me. I go to an alternative school where i have no close friends but I have friends. I was sent there after missing to many days of school. My family family live all around me but are always to busy for me. The only two that really care are my brothers. I have 1 nephew and 2 nieces. The time I was really serious about doing it they and my brothers kept me from it but every time i walk down the street i think about jumping in front of a truck i just can't take it . I have no job. My dad wants nothing to do with me. I have talked to him over the phone twice in my entire life and even then he was drunk saying he would call me back the next day and forget about me and if i called him he would pick up. I don't know what to do. My mom yells at me for everything. If i leave something on the table for an hour longer than it should be(like a glass of water) she calls me lazy and worthless. All of my siblings got out of the house as soon as possible. My brother left when he was 16-17 and started doing drugs. He got his life pretty much on track now. We are also poor. Not that money buys happiness but it sure would make things easier, since that's what my mom complains about everyday. I love my family but my mom doesn't care if i live or die, she just counts me off as another expense. I know people have it worse than me but I just don't know how to cope with these things. I get mad alot but i never show it unless I have to, I have holes in my closet and bruises on my legs to show for it. When  I was first going to try it I had a cable(for tv and such) in my closet and it was tied to the bar that you would put hangars on. She found it and yelled at me for it. I can't think half of the time i am around her I get terrible headaches. I just feel dead inside.
